title: JulOS Host Connector enrollment request, protocol version 1
description: Redeems a single-use enrollment token. The Connector generates CredentialV1 locally; Server stores only SHA256 of its decoded bytes and never echoes it back.

EnrollmentToken.description: Short-lived single-use token created by an administrator.

CredentialV1.description: Base64url without padding over 48 random bytes, which encodes to exactly 64 characters.

MachineIdentity.description: lowercase-hex(SHA256(UTF8("JulOS.Agent\u0000") || UTF8(trimmed machine-id source))). A privacy-bounded duplicate-enrollment probe, never a display name.
